name: Lanatime Daily Summary
query:
SELECT
    employee,
    employee_name,
    DATE(check_time) AS date,

    MIN(CASE 
        WHEN log_type = 'IN' THEN check_time 
    END) AS check_in,

    MAX(CASE 
        WHEN log_type = 'OUT' THEN check_time 
    END) AS check_out,

    SEC_TO_TIME(
        TIMESTAMPDIFF(
            SECOND,
            MIN(CASE WHEN log_type = 'IN' THEN check_time END),
            MAX(CASE WHEN log_type = 'OUT' THEN check_time END)
        )
    ) AS total_hours

FROM `tabLanatime Checkin`

GROUP BY employee, DATE(check_time)

ORDER BY date DESC, employee
